package.name: w3_robot_bridge
package.description: SocketCAN FD-based bridge for Damiao motors via KAS-ROBOT-CANFD USB adapter. Dual-arm robot: 14 arm motors with 2 optional gripper motors on 2 CAN FD channels (1M+5M), 350Hz per-motor force-position hybrid (MIT mode) control. Supports individual and batch motor commands, per-motor YAML config with sign inversion and zero-offset compensation.
